description: Advance one step in the current host agent by default. Only use executionMode=local_runner to spawn a separate local CLI.

agentSetup.description: Optional Stack Setup evidence. The MCP bridge sends localRepoPath, runnerTarget, and clientType automatically.

choiceSelection.description: Optional generated-choice override to apply before continuing, for example { domain: 'wedge', optionTitle: 'Local Plant Walk Companion', resetDownstream: true }.

choiceSelections.description: Optional list of generated-choice overrides to apply once before continuing.

completionTarget.description: Optional completion boundary. build_board_ready stops after board generation and before card execution when supported.

generatedChoices.description: Backward-compatible alias for choiceSelection(s). Prefer choiceSelection. Supports { domain, optionTitle } or { wedge: { optionTitle } }.

ideaSnapshot.description: Optional first-bucket seed for Product Ideation / Idea Snapshot. If the loop is blocked on idea_snapshot, LaunchChair saves this structured brief and continues.

projectName.description: Optional project name to resolve through launchchair_list_projects when projectId is omitted.

stopPhaseKey.description: Optional stop phase. When omitted, LaunchChair selects the correct default for the project workflow.

name: launchchair_continue_project
